# School SOS - LLM Context

## Project Overview
School SOS is a functional full-stack MVP for school incident reporting and management. It allows users to report incidents, track their resolution through a defined workflow, and maintain a complete timeline of actions.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend:** Vue 3, TypeScript, Vuetify 3, Pinia, Vite
- **Backend:** Hono (Cloudflare Workers), TypeScript, Zod
- **Database:** Cloudflare D1 (SQLite)

## Project Structure
```
school-sos/
├── backend/           # Hono API (Cloudflare Workers)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── index.ts           # Entry point + routes
│   │   ├── routes/
│   │   │   └── incidents.ts   # Incident CRUD + resolve
│   │   ├── types/
│   │   │   └── index.ts       # Zod schemas + TypeScript types
│   │   ├── db/
│   │   │   └── schema.ts      # DB row mappers
│   │   └── middleware/
│   │       └── error.ts       # Error handler
│   ├── migrations/
│   │   └── 001_create_tables.sql
│   ├── wrangler.toml
│   └── package.json
├── frontend/          # Vue 3 + Vuetify SPA
│   ├── src/

│   │   ├── router/
│   │   ├── stores/
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /api/health | Health check |
| POST | /api/v1/incidents | Create incident |
| GET | /api/v1/incidents | List incidents (filterable) |
| GET | /api/v1/incidents/:id | Get incident detail + timeline |
| PATCH | /api/v1/incidents/:id | Update incident (status, priority, assignee) |
| POST | /api/v1/incidents/:id/notes | Add timeline note |
| POST | /api/v1/incidents/:id/resolve | Resolve incident |

## Status Workflow
NEW → ACKNOWLEDGED → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED
(ACKNOWLEDGED can revert to NEW, IN_PROGRESS can revert to ACKNOWLEDGED)

## Frontend Routes
- `/dashboard` - Dashboard with stats + incident list
- `/report` - Report a new incident
- `/incidents/:id` - Incident detail with timeline + actions

## Priority Levels
LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

## Key Design Decisions
- No authentication (P0 scope only)
- No AI, WebSocket, GPS, PDF, multi-school features (explicitly out of scope)
- Timeline entries auto-generated from backend on state changes
- Closure summary auto-generated on incident resolution
- Responsive design (mobile + desktop)
